name: QVeris Plugin
description: QVeris capability discovery, tool inspection, and tool calling

apiKey.label: QVeris API Key
apiKey.help: QVeris API key for capability discovery and tool calling (fallback: QVERIS_API_KEY env var).

baseUrl.label: QVeris API Base URL
baseUrl.help: Optional explicit API endpoint (fallback: QVERIS_BASE_URL, then the public default).

discoverCacheTtlSeconds.label: Discover cache TTL
discoverCacheTtlSeconds.help: Session-scoped exact-query cache lifetime in seconds. Set to 0 to disable.

capabilityMemoryTtlSeconds.label: Capability memory TTL
capabilityMemoryTtlSeconds.help: Lifetime in seconds for exact-query successful-capability hints. Set to 0 to disable.

rememberSuccessfulCapabilities.label: Remember successful capabilities
rememberSuccessfulCapabilities.help: Show successful tools as session hints for the same exact normalized capability query.

region.description: Deprecated and rejected at runtime. Remove this field and set baseUrl or QVERIS_BASE_URL explicitly.
